7.4.3.5.3.1 Binary Manifest
The implementation of the Dem Low Proxy may provide some basic infrastructure for
the Dem High Proxy in order to be operational. Such generic infrastructure services
module
can be linked between Application Software Cluster and Host Software
Cluster by means of a Dem base socket.
[SWS_SwCluC_02746]
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00209, SRS_SwCluC_00212
⌈The Dem Low Proxy shall create, for each SwCluCDemProxyBaseSocket, a pro-
vided resource entry in the Binary Manifest.⌋

Status:
